final: WITH per_team AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(g - w) AS team_sum FROM manager WHERE g IS NOT NULL AND w IS NOT NULL GROUP BY team_id), totals AS (SELECT SUM(team_sum) AS overall_total, AVG(team_sum) AS avg_team_sum FROM per_team), matched AS (SELECT p.team_id, p.team_sum, t.overall_total, t.avg_team_sum FROM per_team p JOIN totals t ON t.overall_total IS NOT NULL AND t.avg_team_sum IS NOT NULL WHERE p.team_sum > t.avg_team_sum) SELECT AVG(team_sum) AS avg_kept_team_sum, AVG(1.0 * team_sum / overall_total) AS avg_kept_share, AVG(team_sum - avg_team_sum) AS avg_excess_overall_team_avg FROM matched
